headline: Three Touchdowns at Arrowhead Show Why Patrick Mahomes' Chiefs No. 15 Never Fades
title: Patrick Mahomes: 324 Yards and 3 TDs in Rout of Arizona
subheadline: Kansas City's third straight win moved the Chiefs to 8-2 ahead of a Thanksgiving night trip to Buffalo.
description: Patrick Mahomes threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns as the Chiefs beat Arizona 34-7 on Nov. 22. Why his No. 15 Chiefs jersey is still a top pick for fans.
searchIntent: Chiefs and NFL fans who saw the win over Arizona want the key numbers and the right No. 15 jersey.
body: Patrick Mahomes threw for 324 yards and three touchdowns on Nov. 22 as Kansas City beat Arizona 34-7 at Arrowhead Stadium. Two of those scores went to Travis Kelce, who finished with six catches for 74 yards.
The Chiefs piled up 435 yards, won their third game in a row and moved to 8-2, including 5-0 at home.
## Why fans are buying in

Mahomes does not need a breakout to stay relevant. He is a three-time Super Bowl champion and a three-time Super Bowl MVP, and Sunday was a reminder of why his name still leads so many Chiefs conversations. Kansas City controlled the game from the first quarter, and the offense looked like the steady, balanced unit fans expect in the second half of a season.

His jersey has the numbers behind it, too. On the NFLPA's year-end Top 50 player sales list, which covers licensed player merchandise sold from March 1, 2025 to Feb. 28, 2026, Mahomes ranked sixth. That list counts all licensed player products, not jerseys alone, but it shows how far his following reaches beyond Kansas City.

In our analysis, a quarterback in his prime on an 8-2 team is about as safe a jersey choice as there is. Fans who buy No. 15 are buying into a player who should be the face of the franchise for years.
## The look

The banner above shows his No. 15 in the Chiefs' classic red home jersey and the white road version with red numbers. Both are simple, bold designs that have barely changed in decades, which is part of their appeal: they look right in any season.
## Why this jersey will last

The next test is a big one. The Chiefs travel to Buffalo on Thanksgiving night to face a Bills team that sits at 9-1, a matchup with real playoff seeding on the line. A strong night there would only add to the story of this season.

headline: Josh Hart Is Chasing Walt Frazier. Make His Knicks No. 3 Part of the Pursuit
title: Josh Hart: 18th Triple-Double Moves Him Up the Knicks List
subheadline: His 10-point, 11-assist, 10-rebound night helped New York beat Indiana for a fifth straight win.
description: Josh Hart had 10 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds as the Knicks beat Indiana on Nov. 22, his 18th triple-double for New York. Why his No. 3 jersey fits.
searchIntent: Knicks fans who saw Hart's triple-double want to know where it ranks in team history and which No. 3 jersey to get.
body: Josh Hart posted 10 points, 11 assists and 10 rebounds on Nov. 22 as the Knicks beat Indiana 113-106 at Madison Square Garden. It was his 18th triple-double in a New York uniform.
That ties Michael Ray Richardson for second on the franchise list. Only Walt Frazier, with 23, has more.
## Why fans are buying in

Hart has never been the Knicks' top scorer, and that is exactly why fans connect with him. Karl-Anthony Towns led the way with 30 points and 13 rebounds, and Jalen Brunson added 22, while Hart did the work that fills every other column of the box score. He crashes the glass like a big man, pushes the ball in transition and keeps finding teammates.

His record shows it is not a one-night thing. Last season he averaged 12.0 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists over 66 games, then averaged 8.9 rebounds in 19 playoff games. Now he is closing in on a franchise mark held by one of the most famous players in Knicks history.

The team is giving fans plenty to cheer, too. The win was New York's fifth in a row and lifted the Knicks to 11-6. In our analysis, a hustle player on a winning team in the league's biggest market is the kind of jersey that becomes a fan favorite and stays one.
## The look

The banner above shows his No. 3 in the Knicks' blue Icon Edition, the familiar home look with orange trim, and the black Statement Edition for fans who want something a little different at the Garden.
## Why this jersey will last
Hart is five triple-doubles behind Frazier, and every one he adds keeps that chase in the headlines. The Knicks stay home to face Cleveland on Wednesday as part of a five-game homestand.

headline: Six Touchdown Drives in a Row Put Dak Prescott's Cowboys No. 4 Front and Center
title: Dak Prescott: Five Touchdowns as Dallas Scores 51 Points
subheadline: He completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards in a 51-30 rout of Tennessee at AT&T Stadium.
description: Dak Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards and four TDs, and ran for a fifth, in a 51-30 Cowboys win on Nov. 22. Why his No. 4 jersey is in focus.
searchIntent: Cowboys fans who saw the 51-point win want the key numbers and the right No. 4 jersey.
body: Dak Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards and four touchdowns on Nov. 22, and ran for another score, as Dallas beat Tennessee 51-30 at AT&T Stadium. He did not throw an interception.
The Cowboys scored touchdowns on their first six possessions, and the win evened out a bumpy stretch at 5-6.
## Why fans are buying in

Prescott spread the ball to the two receivers who make this offense dangerous. CeeDee Lamb caught 11 passes for 132 yards and a touchdown, and George Pickens added seven catches for 102 yards and a score. When the passing game works like that, Dallas can put up points on anyone.

Prescott has been doing this for a while. In 2025 he threw for 4,552 yards and 30 touchdowns in 17 games, and he has been the Cowboys' starter since his rookie season in 2016. For a fan base that follows its quarterback as closely as any in the sport, a five-touchdown afternoon is a reminder of what he can still do.
In our analysis, the timing makes his jersey worth a look. Dallas is fighting to climb back into the playoff picture, and a quarterback playing this well can turn a .500 team into a December story.
## The look
The banner above shows his No. 4 in the Cowboys' white jersey, the navy version and the navy alternate. The white with the stars on the shoulders is one of the most recognizable jerseys in football.
## Why this jersey will last

The spotlight only gets brighter from here. Dallas faces Philadelphia on Thanksgiving, the kind of national stage where Cowboys quarterbacks are remembered. Another big game there would keep the momentum going into the final stretch.
